description: Cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and automation using serverless actors and developer APIs.
auth_notes: Authentication uses secret personal or organization API tokens supplied as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header or via OAuth2 (for hosted MCP and platform integrations).
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free tier account self-serve and generate API tokens directly in the Apify Console.
api_notes: The comprehensive REST API and official SDKs cover actor management, builds, runs, actor tasks, storage (datasets, key-value stores, request queues), webhooks, schedules, and user management.
mcp_notes: Official Apify Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Apify at https://mcp.apify.com and open-sourced via apify/apify-mcp-server.
rationale: Apify provides a fully documented REST API, official SDKs, self-serve free credentials, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready to use as an agent toolkit today.

evidence.note: Documents API token creation and authentication via Bearer header or token query parameter.
Describes how to create personal and scoped API tokens via the Apify Console.
Full REST API reference covering actors, runs, storage, webhooks, schedules, and usage.
Official repository for the Apify MCP server providing web scraping and automation tools for AI agents.
